_comment: The one Rust → Go platform table. The sidecar build (scripts/build-bridge-sidecar.mjs) maps a Rust target triple's components through it; the shell (src-tauri, sidecar_util::current_platform) maps its own std::env::consts OS/ARCH through it to name catalog artifacts (<goos>-<goarch>). A value missing here is unsupported on both sides.
